controls.name: horizontal_edge_weight
controls.definition: Tunable horizontal edge weight alpha in the 2-by-1 periodic weighted triangular-lattice quantum dimer model, with the other five edge weights fixed to one.

readouts.name: topological_min_entropy
readouts.definition: Topological Renyi entropy of order infinity (topological min-entropy).

applicability.statement: Applies away from the critical point to the source's 2-by-1 periodic triangular-lattice generalized RK model at the RK point, with one tunable horizontal edge weight and all other weights equal to one.
